candidates.statement: Redis reserve_inventory operations time out (~2s) causing inventory /v1/reservations to return 503, which propagates as ReadTimeout transport errors through order and gateway, yielding 502 on /v1/checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: No Redis-side metrics/logs admitted; whether the timeout stems from Redis saturation, network, or config is unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Traces show redis.reserve_inventory timing out (~2s) with DependencyUnavailable, inventory returning 503, and order/gateway surfacing ReadTimeout transport errors and 502 on /v1/checkout. Gateway metrics show 16 502s on /v1/checkout with p95 ~2425ms, consistent with the ~2s dependency timeout. Topology confirms inventory->redis dependency. Bounded candidate: redis-timeout.
missing_evidence: Redis server-side latency/error metrics and logs to confirm the timeout origin
Inventory service logs correlating reserve_inventory failures
